universities-world.selection: All sciences; world; 2020–2023; fractional counting; core publications only; minimum P=1000; descending P(top 10%).
universities-world.limitations: One research-volume measure. No teaching, fees, employment or overall university rank.

universities-europe.selection: All sciences; Europe; 2020–2023; fractional counting; core publications only; minimum P=1000; descending P(top 10%).
universities-europe.limitations: One research-volume measure. No teaching, fees, employment or overall university rank.

grammar-schools-uk.selection: Open, state-funded, Secondary, Selective; round-robin by local authority; alphabetical within each authority.
grammar-schools-uk.limitations: England only. Numbers are not performance ranks.

high-schools-england.selection: Open, state-funded, Secondary, Non-selective; round-robin across English regions; alphabetical within each region.

finance-schools-us.selection: CIP 52.0801 Finance, General; award level 5 bachelor; first major; active institution; positive completions; descending CTOTALT.
finance-schools-us.limitations: Completion volume, not quality or employment. Broader business, accounting, economics and graduate-only programmes are excluded.

high-schools-usa.selection: 2023–24 CCD version 1a; open/new/added/changed regular High schools offering grades 9 and 12; two per state via geographic round-robin.
high-schools-usa.limitations: 50 states only. Historical directory edition. No performance ranking.

private-schools-canada.source: CAIS directory and Ontario private-school contact list
private-schools-canada.selection: All 97 Canadian CAIS records, then 3 non-duplicate Ontario records selected by location/alphabetical round-robin.
private-schools-canada.limitations: Not all schools are secondary. Membership and government listing are not quality endorsement; verify diploma-credit authority.

high-schools-canada.source: CAIS directory and Ontario public-school contact list
high-schools-canada.selection: 60 Canadian CAIS records with secondary grades and 40 Ontario public secondary records; geographic round-robin.
high-schools-canada.limitations: Public-school coverage is Ontario only. Provincial qualifications differ; no performance rank.

schools-australia.source: NSW Department of Education; Victoria school locations 2025; Queensland NSSAB register
schools-australia.selection: 34 NSW government secondary/central schools + 33 Victorian open secondary/combined + 33 Queensland open non-state host-centre secondary schools; geographic round-robin.
schools-australia.limitations: Three states only. Sector coverage differs. No NAPLAN, ATAR or ICSEA ranking.

private-schools-world.source: GIAS England, CAIS Canada and Victoria school locations
private-schools-world.selection: 35 English independent schools ages extending into secondary + 35 Canadian CAIS schools + 30 Victorian non-government secondary/combined schools.
private-schools-world.limitations: Three-country sample only. Different directory definitions; no global quality rank.

boarding-schools-world.source: TABS public school directory and GIAS England
boarding-schools-world.selection: 35 English independent boarding records + all non-US TABS records not duplicating the English selection + US records to reach 100; geographic sampling.
boarding-schools-world.limitations: Coverage concentrated in England and USA. Directory status does not independently verify residential safety.

international-schools-world.selection: Country searches; names contain International and School; listed school website; geographic round-robin. Countries: Brazil, China, France, Germany, Indonesia, Japan, Kenya, Malaysia, Mexico, Singapore, South Africa, Switzerland, Thailand, UAE, UK
international-schools-world.limitations: Cambridge subset and name filter only; excludes many international schools. Does not establish IB authorization, ownership, eligibility or boarding.

international-schools-asia.selection: Country searches; names contain International and School; listed school website; geographic round-robin. Countries: China, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, UAE
international-schools-asia.limitations: Cambridge subset and name filter only; excludes many international schools. Does not establish IB authorization, ownership, eligibility or boarding.

schools-india.selection: 10 state/UT queries; Senior Secondary Level; published website; 10 records per area through geographic round-robin.
schools-india.limitations: CBSE only; 10 areas; no national board-wide performance ranking. Recheck affiliation and subjects for the intended intake.

medical-colleges-india.source: NIRF 2025 Medical ranking and participant list
medical-colleges-india.selection: All 50 official ranked institutions, in published rank order; then 50 non-duplicate participants geographically sampled.
medical-colleges-india.limitations: Rows 51–100 are unranked participants, not invented ranks. Not a list of 100 verified MBBS providers; verify course and year with the competent regulator.
